title: Sign-in tokens are single-use, time-limited, and superseded by the next mint
description: Every sign-in token minted by the magic-link flow is consumable exactly once. A consumed token cannot be exchanged for a session a second time; an unconsumed token past its expiry cannot be exchanged either. When a fresh token is minted for a principal that has an outstanding unconsumed token, the outstanding token is invalidated at mint time so only the newest token can consume. Token expiry is bounded by a project-configurable window whose default the blueprint fixes at fifteen minutes.
rationale: A reusable token is a stolen-link problem waiting to happen; a token with no ceiling on lifetime is a permanent bearer credential mailed in plaintext. Bounding both dimensions and invalidating predecessors on remint means an intercepted or archived link stops working the moment the operator asks for another one.
